description: The belt life. He comes and goes through the conveyor's OWN cut-out, never up the wall — a climb is invisible at the top and was the source of every collision NPC-003's route probe found. Rail run or jar ride is the shared `mode` draw (W9, 2026-09-24) — it was a LOCAL counter alternating from each client's page load, so every entry's first run was the rail, a ride came ~27 min in on average, no device leg ever saw one, and two devices could show different habits for the same fire. Appended LAST so no other draw's stream moved; the rail measures 94 % visible down run A and a jar lid 100 %, against 0 % for the belt's top surface. DP-W8: a jar goes over as he passes it. The wobble is HIS — 12 s in, which is where the run puts him among the jars rather than still in the cut-out — and once in 25 runs he puts one off the edge entirely. `slot` is a fraction of the LIVE run, never an index: the belt has moved by the time the track is dispatched, so an authored index would name a different jar on every client.
